headline: Trump Threatens Ban on U.S. Tech Firms Building Data Centers Abroad
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump suggested prohibiting American technology companies from constructing data centers overseas. He also proposed potential taxes on firms that build computing infrastructure outside the United States.
why: U.S. technology leaders rely on international data center expansion to deliver cloud services and artificial intelligence computing globally. Potential regulatory barriers or tariffs could disrupt global supply chain investments.
